tracked_twin_families.rationale: Private helper imports were collapsed into the public span-helper seam in issue #4485. The public budget now reflects the canonicalized importer count, while private import growth is limited to the public re-export module only.

Issue #4485 collapsed first-party runtime-builder imports onto the public `run_manifest_support` seam. The public budget now reflects the canonicalized importer count, while private imports are limited to the public re-export module only.
The policy-registry twin remains active on the canonical ChEMBL normalization path and should not grow while the family stays split.
The data companion to the policy-registry twin is still split and should stay under a matching no-growth ratchet.

symbols.rationale: `Settings` remains an external convenience type import, but first-party source modules must import the canonical owner type directly instead of flowing through the broad package-root facade.
`get_settings` remains an external convenience seam, but first-party runtime/bootstrap paths must import the canonical owner helper directly instead of flowing through the package root.
Contract-policy loading is still allowed through the package root only for the current pipeline factory slice. New first-party growth must go through reviewed inventory updates first.
